metaTitle: Cert IV Training and Assessment Fast Track RPL | TAE40122
metaDescription: Fast track your TAE40122 Cert IV in Training and Assessment with RPL. Use your training experience, 100% online, 4–10 weeks. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: Already training staff, running inductions or assessing people at work? The TAE40122 Certificate IV in Training and Assessment through RPL turns that experience into the credential trainers and assessors need in Australia's vocational training sector. Everything is done online, and you only fill gaps rather than redo what you already know.
whoIsItFor:
The TAE40122 is the standard qualification for trainers and assessors in registered training organisations (RTOs), and it's widely valued for workplace training roles. RPL suits people who already plan, deliver and assess training:

  • Workplace trainers, inductors and learning and development staff
  • Supervisors and team leaders who train and sign off new staff
  • Industry experts who want to teach their trade at an RTO or TAFE
  • Trainers holding the older TAE40116 who want the current version
  • Teachers and educators moving into vocational training

You need real, recent experience delivering and assessing training, ideally against units of competency or documented workplace standards. Because the regulator watches TAE qualifications closely, assessors expect genuine evidence, not just a job title.
evidenceExamples:
TAE evidence should show you designing, delivering and assessing training. Useful evidence includes:

  • Session plans, lesson plans or training programs you've written
  • Recordings of you delivering training, face to face or online
  • Assessment tools you've developed or used, with completed assessment records
  • Learner feedback, attendance records and training evaluations
  • Validation or moderation records, if you've taken part
  • Your industry qualifications and a CV showing training duties
  • A reference from a manager or RTO describing your training role

Assessors usually ask you to deliver and assess a live or recorded session as part of the process. We'll help you plan it.
description:
The TAE40122 Certificate IV in Training and Assessment covers the skills to design and deliver training and assess competency in the vocational education and training (VET) sector and in workplaces: planning and delivering group and workplace-based training, designing and developing assessment tools, conducting assessments, taking part in validation, and supporting learners' language, literacy and numeracy.

It replaced TAE40116, with new units on learner support and assessment. Through RPL, your existing training work is mapped to each unit, and any gaps are covered with targeted tasks.
jobOpportunity: Trainer and assessor at an RTO or TAFE
Assessor for workplace or industry programs
searchAliases: certificate iv in training and assessment rpl
imageAlt: Trainer delivering a workplace training session to a small group

faqs.q: Can I get the TAE40122 Certificate IV in Training and Assessment through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you already plan, deliver and assess training. The assessor reviews your session plans, training recordings and assessment records, and you complete targeted tasks for any gaps. If you've never trained or assessed anyone, RPL isn't the right fit and full study is better.

faqs.q: How fast can I get TAE40122 through RPL?
faqs.a: Most candidates finish in 4 to 10 weeks. Trainers who already have session plans, assessment tools and a recording of their delivery tend to finish faster. TAE assessments are thorough, so beware of anyone promising it in days.

faqs.q: Can I do TAE40122 RPL 100% online?
faqs.a: Yes. Evidence is uploaded online, interviews are by video, and the delivery and assessment observations can be recorded or done live over video. You can be anywhere in Australia.

faqs.q: I have TAE40116. Do I need to upgrade to TAE40122?
faqs.a: TAE40116 is an older version. Many RTOs now ask trainers to hold the current TAE40122, and your existing units count toward it through credit transfer, so an upgrade is usually much shorter than the full qualification. Tell us what you hold and we'll check what's left.

It depends on your evidence, any credit from TAE40116 units, and how much gap work you need. RPL is generally cheaper and faster than enrolling in the full course. Get a free eligibility check for a clear quote.

faqs.q: Do I need industry experience as well?
faqs.a: To get the TAE40122 you need training and assessment experience. To actually teach at an RTO you also need current industry skills and qualifications in the area you'll teach, which the RTO checks when it employs you.

faqs.q: Is a TAE40122 from RPL the same as from full study?
faqs.a: Yes. It's the same nationally recognised qualification, issued by a registered training organisation, and the certificate doesn't say it was gained through RPL.
